# HLA

> Hidden Lake Adapters

<img src="images/hla_logo.png" alt="hla_logo.png"/>

`Hidden Lake Adapters` allow you to adapt anonymizing traffic to various communication protocols and platforms.

## List of adapters

1. [HLA=tcp](hla-tcp) - adapts HL traffic over TCP protocol
2. [HLA=http](hla-http) - adapts HL traffic over HTTP protocol
2. [HLA=https](hla-https) - adapts HL traffic over HTTPS protocol
2. [HLA=meshtastic](hla-meshtastic) - adapts HL traffic over Meshtastic/LoRa protocol

## Installation

It is necessary to replace `<proto>` with an existing adapter in the list.

```bash
$ go install github.com/number571/hidden-lake/cmd/hla/hla-<proto>@latest
```

## How it works

HLA are based on two functions: `Consume` and `Produce`. Due to this, at the interface level, users do not care about the nature of communication: where ciphertexts are read from and where they are written. Due to this property, as well as the properties of QB networks to preserve anonymity in any communication environment, it becomes possible to write adapters not only for network protocols, but also for centralized services, thereby creating secret communication channels.

## Supported platforms

- Windows (x86_64, arm64)
- Linux (x86_64, arm64)
- MacOS (x86_64, arm64)

## Build and run

Default build and run

```bash 
$ go run ./cmd/hla/hla-<proto>

> [INFO] 2024/12/29 03:40:06 HLA=<proto> is started
> ...
```

Creates [`./hla-<proto>.yml`](./hla-tcp/hla-tcp.yml) file (as example `tcp`).

## Running options

```bash
$ hla-<proto> --path /root --network xxx
# path    = path to config, database, key files
# network = use network configuration from networks.yml
```

## HLA API

> [!NOTE]
> The internal API of all adapters must be the same. Because of this, all adapters inherit adapter HLA=HTTP.

```
1. GET             /api/index          	| params = []
                            			|> description = get name of service
2. GET/POST/DELETE /api/config/connects	| params = []
                            			|> description = get/add/del connections via adapter
3. GET             /api/config/settings	| params = []
                            			|> description = get current settings
4. GET/DELETE      /api/network/online	| params = []
                            			|> description = get/disconnect current online connections
5. GET             /adapter/consume     | params = ["sid":string]
                                        |> description = recv HL message from connections
6. POST            /adapter/produce     | params = []
                                        |> description = send HL message to connections
```

### 1. /api/index

- `200` - return "hidden-lake-adapter=http"

#### 1.1. GET Request

```bash
curl -i -X GET http://localhost:9502/api/index
```

#### 1.1. GET Response

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/plain
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 10:30:39 GMT
Content-Length: 24

hidden-lake-adapter=http
```

### 2. /api/config/connects

- `200` - return list of connections / add connection / del connection
- `202` - got connection with scheme != http  
- `405` - invalid method (not GET, POST, DELETE)
- `409` - failed read HTTP request body
- `418` - receive void connect string
- `502` - get response from HLA (get, add, del)

#### 2.1. GET Request

```bash
curl -i -X GET http://localhost:9502/api/config/connects
```

#### 2.1. GET Response

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
Date: Mon, 07 Aug 2023 00:21:25 GMT
Content-Length: 49
```

```json
["http://localhost:9581","http://localhost:8888"]
```

#### 2.2. POST Request

```bash
curl -i -X POST http://localhost:9502/api/config/connects --data 'http://localhost:8888'
```

#### 2.2. POST Response

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/plain
Date: Mon, 07 Aug 2023 00:21:17 GMT
Content-Length: 27

success: update connections
```

#### 2.3. DELETE Request

```bash
curl -i -X DELETE http://localhost:9502/api/config/connects --data 'http://localhost:8888'
```

#### 2.3. DELETE Response

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/plain
Date: Mon, 07 Aug 2023 00:21:46 GMT
Content-Length: 26

success: delete connection
```

### 3. /api/config/settings

- `200` - return settings from config
- `405` - invalid method (not GET)

#### 3.1. GET Request

```bash
curl -i -X GET http://localhost:9502/api/config/settings
```

#### 3.1. GET Response

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
Date: Sun, 12 Nov 2023 19:01:38 GMT
Content-Length: 120
```

```json
{"message_size_bytes":8192,"queue_period_ms":5000,"work_size_bits":22}
```

### 4. /api/network/online

- `200` - return list of online connections / del online connection  
- `202` - got connection with scheme != http  
- `405` - invalid method (not GET, DELETE)
- `409` - failed read connect string
- `502` - get response from HLA (get, del)

#### 4.1. GET Request

```bash
curl -i -X GET http://localhost:9502/api/network/online
```

#### 4.1. GET Response

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
Date: Mon, 07 Aug 2023 00:23:25 GMT
Content-Length: 25
```

```json
["http://localhost:9581"]
```

#### 4.2. DELETE Request

```bash
curl -i -X DELETE http://localhost:9502/api/network/online --data 'http://localhost:9581'
```

#### 4.2. DELETE Response

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/plain
Date: Mon, 07 Aug 2023 00:24:14 GMT
Content-Length: 33

success: delete online connection
```

### 5. /adapter/consume

- `200` - return message
- `204` - no received messages
- `405` - invalid method (not GET)
- `406` - subscriber id not registered
- `500` - failed type conversion message

#### 5.1. GET Request

```bash
curl -i -X GET http://localhost:9502/adapter/consume
```

#### 5.1. GET Response

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/plain
Date: Mon, 07 Aug 2023 00:23:25 GMT
Transfer-Encoding: chunked


```

### 6. /adapter/produce

- `200` - return ok
- `202` - message already has in the cache
- `400` - failed load message (invalid format, another settings)
- `405` - invalid method (not POST)
- `418` - invalid message size
- `500` - channel messages overflow
- `502` - get response from HLA (get, del)

#### 6.1. POST Request

```bash
curl -i -X POST http://localhost:9502/adapter/produce --data ''
```

#### 6.1. POST Response

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/plain
Date: Mon, 07 Aug 2023 00:21:17 GMT
Content-Length: 0
```
